No.81/1/2022-EO(CVO)
Government of India
Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions
Department of Personnel & Training
*****

North Block, New Delhi
Dated the 22nd July, 2025
Subject: Entrustment of additional charge of the post of CVO, SJVNL, Shimla.

Reference: Ministry of Power’s O.M No. C-30019/5/2022-V&S dated 17.07.2025 on
the subject mentioned above.

2. The Competent Authority has approved the proposal for entrustment of additional
charge of the post of CVO, Satluj Jal Vidyut Nigam Ltd. (SJVNL), Shimla to Ms. Vinita
Narera, IRSSE (2000), CVO, Rural Electrification Corporation Ltd. (REC), Delhi for a period
of six months from the date of assumption of charge of the post or till the appointment of a
regular CVO in SJVNL or until further orders, whichever is the earliest.

(P. P. Singh)
Under Secretary to the Government of India
Tel. No. 23092589

Ministry of Power
[Shri M. K. Chahar, Under Secretary]
Shram Shakti Bhawan, Rafi Marg,
 New Delhi.

Copy for information to:-

1. The Secretary, Central Vigilance Commission, Satarkta Bhawan, GPO Complex, Block-A,
 INA, New Delhi-110023.
2. PS to MOS(PP)/PSO to Secretary(P)/PPS to EO/DIR(SM)/DS(MM).
3. Guard File.
